title: Pentagon confirms Navy thermal footage

tellings.quote: what's so interesting about this footage is it has now been confirmed by the Pentagon that it is actual Navy filmed footage

plain: A piece of thermal camera footage, filmed in heat-sensing infrared, shows an unexplained object, and according to Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who reports on UFOs, the Pentagon has "confirmed" that "it is actual Navy filmed footage." Corbell says this in an episode about the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer. If he is right, the US military has admitted the video is real and its own.
